listing.name: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection (nxnative-aa-port)
listing.summary: An experimental nxnative-based Ace Attorney Investigations Collection compatibility fork for Apple Silicon Mac and iOS. The project reports Unity IL2CPP dialogue, menus, saving, loading and input at 1080p; courts and a complete playthrough are unconfirmed. There is no release package. Follow the Mac source build for dm/host/dmhost with the title’s GAME setting and explicit patched-module, RomFS, shader, font and save paths; the iOS script builds an IPA. Use your own base v1.0.0 game, title 010005501E68C000, and prod.keys, with patched_v0 and the required extracted RomFS, shader and save paths. Exact region and file hashes are unconfirmed. You manage rebuilding and preserving saves; compatibility across updates and other desktop platforms is unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
